dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: We've also taken up some of the setup work for this Irodori Festival here at Sailing Breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Not only that, we've also gotten ourselves a collaboration with the light novel "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?". We'll be selling a limited number of collaborative drinks every day!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: The drink has some products from Mondstadt in it and tastes very unique as a result. Do come and give it a go.
